evidence.reason: The denylist is a required fail-closed gate (contract item 17). Gitleaks honors inline `gitleaks:allow` directives by default; PR-controlled content can place one on the same line as a prohibited commit-message value, so the cited `gitleaks stdin` scan (and the two `gitleaks git` scans above it) can discard the finding. Adding `--ignore-gitleaks-allow` enforces the existing trusted policy; this is a routine correctness/security repair, not a new requirement or owner decision.
